relations.text: 製造パートナー。最初の12基分の原子炉上部容器の長納期品を発注し、製造が進む
relations.text_en: Manufacturing partner; long-lead items for the first twelve upper reactor vessels are on order and in production

source.label: NuScale 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have placed orders for Long-lead items for the first twelve NPM upper reactor vessels, including forgings, tubing, tube bending machines and weld materials with Doosan Enerbility Co., Ltd, the Company’s manufacturing partner.

relations.text: 原子炉モジュールの部品を製造する主要供給元の一社

source.quote: Management continues to focus on partnerships with suppliers, such as Doosan Enerbility Co., Ltd.; IHI Corporation; Precision Custom Components LLC; Sarens Nuclear & Industrial Services, LLC; and Curtiss-Wright Corporation

relations.text: 合弁RoPowerを通じて、ルーマニアのDoicesti発電所で6基の計画を進める顧客
relations.text_en: Customer through its RoPower joint venture, planning a six-module plant at Doicesti, Romania

source.label: NuScale 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The customer is RoPower Nuclear S.A. ("RoPower"), which is a joint venture established by S.N. Nuclearelectrica S.A. ("Nuclearelectrica") and Nova Power & Gas S.A.
source.note: 建設前の段階で、受注契約はまだありません。
source.note_en: Pre-construction; no binding module order yet.
